Internet, Home & Wireless Networking

Whether your home internet comes through cable, fiber, or DSL, getting the most out of your connection depends on a properly configured modem and router. Speeds can drop quickly when multiple users and devices share a network, and if proper security is not in place, virtually any computer on your network can view your information. Bob the Tech Guy is knowledgeable in modem and router setup across all major service types and will make sure your equipment is running properly. Wireless Networking

The way homes and small businesses interconnect devices has changed dramatically. It's no longer just computer-to-computer: tablets, phones, printers, home entertainment centers, security systems, smart lighting and more all share the same wireless network. While wireless technology offers an amazing array of solutions to everyday problems, it is not fool-proof and may require expertise in its set-up and troubleshooting. Sometimes the fix is simple, such as proper router placement, while other times it calls for wireless repeaters, mesh systems, or channel adjustments. Bob the Tech Guy is an expert at solving wireless interconnectivity challenges within your home or small business space.
